author: Le_Monke33
quote: I have been a huge fan of the games since gta san andreas. I average around 3k hours in gta 5, the reason i played so much is that it felt like a proper sandbox and you could actually do what the game was supposed to. Unfortunately, after 25 ish hours of playing gta 6 i realised that this is nothing more than gay cuckold simulator. Woke culture ruined gta forever. Don’t get me started on the bugs.
